fe-design-archetype.detail: Re-judged this pass by opening evidence/screenshots/az-planting-calendar-1280-light.png (regenerated by this gate run) and reading it, against Option 3 'Timeline + rail' as chosen in az-planting-calendar/design-refs/home-options/DECISION.md line 13. Three of the four structural claims hold as written: the horizontal half-month timeline is the hero under the heading 'Half-month timeline', rendering a count chip per half-month with Aug 1 selected and marked NOW; crop rows are secondary beneath it under 'Plantable in Aug 1', 7 crops each with image, method badge, days-to-harvest and a cited source link; the planting assistant is a docked desktop right rail rather than a floating button. DEVIATION, recorded rather than smoothed over: the zone IS a full-width bar ('Planning zone (Maricopa County low desert)') but it sits BELOW the crop search, not above it -- search is in the sticky top chrome. DECISION.md line 9 lists search placement as a separable piece with 'sticky chrome' among its sanctioned options, so this is a permitted mix rather than a departure from the chosen archetype; but the previous record asserted 'zone is a full-width bar above search', which the rendered page does not show. Judged from the rendered screenshot, not from component source. The per-half-month counts are visible on the chips but are not restated here: the image was reviewed downscaled, single digits are not reliably legible at that size, and the previous record's count string disagrees with what is readable, so quoting them would be a guess.
